name: What is the typical deposit structure for pre-construction condos in Florida?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical deposit structure for pre-construction condos in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Florida, the typical deposit structure for pre-construction condos often involves several installment payments, usually ranging from 10% to 20% at contract signing, another 10% after a certain construction milestone, and subsequent payments until closing. This phased payment approach is a practical tradeoff, as it allows buyers to spread out their financial commitment over time. We help clients understand these deposit schedules for projects across Miami-Dade and Broward Counties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Florida pre-construction condo deposits are typically paid in installments, starting with 10-20% at contract and continuing through construction.
